title: ConicFlow: constrained Inference-time optimal control for flow matching models
abstract: arXiv:2610.14307v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose ConicFlow, which frames constrained sampling from a flow matching model at inference time as an optimal control problem that balances deviation from the pretrained trajectory against reward, subject to hard terminal constraints. We discretize this problem and adapt receding-horizon control, optimizing only a short window of the trajectory at each step for computational tractability. We address the resulting sequence of receding-horizon subproblems with a receding-horizon primal-dual algorithm. Its dual multipliers capture the difficulty of satisfying each constraint and are refined throughout sampling, steering generation toward feasible final samples. We further propose a terminal-estimate variant that avoids accumulating local truncation errors by evaluating the reward and constraints at the predicted terminal point rather than at the end of the current horizon. translated_title: ConicFlow：面向流匹配模型的约束推理时最优控制
translated_abstract: 我们提出了ConicFlow，该方法将在推理阶段从流匹配模型中进行约束采样的问题构建为一个最优控制问题，在偏离预训练轨迹与获得奖励之间进行权衡，同时满足硬性终端约束。我们对这一问题进行离散化，并采用滚动时域控制方法，每一步仅优化轨迹的一小段窗口以保证计算上的可处理性。我们使用滚动时域原始-对偶算法来求解由此产生的一系列滚动时域子问题。其对偶乘子能够刻画满足每个约束的难度，并在整个采样过程中不断更新，从而引导生成过程朝向可行的最终样本。我们进一步提出了一种终端估计变体，通过在预测的终端点而非当前时域末端评估奖励和约束，从而避免局部截断误差的累积。在标准的正则性假设下，我们建立了有限时域（原文在此处被截断）……
tldr: ConicFlow将在推理阶段对流匹配模型施加约束采样的任务转化为带硬终端约束的最优控制问题，并借助滚动时域原始-对偶算法及其终端估计变体高效求解，在控制轨迹偏离的同时生成满足约束的样本。
en_tdlr: ConicFlow formulates constrained sampling from flow matching models at inference time as an optimal control problem with hard terminal constraints, solved via a receding-horizon primal-dual algorithm that steers generation toward feasible final samples.
